_note: EU Machinery Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2023/1230) Annex I classification lookup. Categories paraphrase the Annex I Part A and Part B lists; the class drives the conformity-assessment route under Article 25. Same shape as the CRA lookup so the shared layered-conformance machinery (scoring-cra.js) can use either.

classes.label: Not listed in Annex I (internal control)
Annex I Part A (third party mandatory)

routeByClass.default: Internal production control (Module A, Annex VI): manufacturer self-assessment; no notified body required.
routeByClass.annex-i-part-b: Internal production control (Module A) is permitted ONLY where the machine is designed and constructed fully in accordance with harmonised standards or common specifications covering ALL the relevant essential health and safety requirements (Art 25(3)). Otherwise a notified-body route is required: EU type-examination (Module B) + conformity to type (Module C), full quality assurance (Module H), or unit verification (Module G).
routeByClass.annex-i-part-a: Third-party conformity assessment is mandatory (Art 25(2)): EU type-examination (Module B) + conformity to type (Module C), full quality assurance (Module H), or unit verification (Module G). Internal control (Module A) is not available.

groupLabels.annex-i-part-a: Annex I Part A (third-party assessment mandatory)
groupLabels.annex-i-part-b: Annex I Part B (Module A only with full harmonised-standard coverage)

annex-i-part-a.text: Removable mechanical transmission devices, including their guards
Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices
Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery
Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine-learning approaches ensuring safety functions
Machinery embedding self-evolving (machine-learning) systems ensuring safety functions that were not placed independently on the market, in respect of those systems

annex-i-part-b.text: Circular saws for wood/similar or meat/similar (fixed or movable blade types listed in Part B point 1)
Hand-fed surface planing machinery for woodworking
Thicknessers for one-side dressing with built-in mechanical feed, manual loading/unloading, for woodworking
Band-saws with manual loading/unloading for wood/similar or meat/similar
Combined machinery of the sawing/planing/moulding types for wood and similar materials
Hand-fed tenoning machinery with several tool holders for woodworking
Hand-fed vertical spindle moulding machinery for wood and similar materials
Presses, including press-brakes, for cold working of metals, manual loading/unloading, travel > 6 mm and speed > 30 mm/s
Injection or compression plastics-moulding machinery with manual loading or unloading
Injection or compression rubber-moulding machinery with manual loading or unloading
Machinery for underground working: locomotives and brake-vans; hydraulic-powered roof supports
Manually loaded trucks for the collection of household refuse incorporating a compression mechanism
Devices for lifting persons, or persons and goods, involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than 3 m
Protective devices designed to detect the presence of persons
Power-operated interlocking movable guards used as safeguards in presses and moulding machinery (Part B points 9-11)
Logic units to ensure safety functions

classifierFlags.selfEvolvingSafety: A machine whose safety functions rely on a fully or partially self-evolving (machine-learning) system falls under Annex I Part A points 5-6: third-party conformity assessment is mandatory for those systems even where the rest of the machine would self-assess.
